title: Refactor Go Kit API to Stateful with Five Kit Kinds
description: Refactored all ~36 apply*Diff functions in compose/go/main.go from functional (returning new values) to in-place mutation (void, pointer receivers). Renamed KitKind enum values: File->Dev, Folder->Local, Temporary->Transport. Added Kit Kind types (TransportKit, ArchiveKit, SyncKit interface, DevKit, LocalKit, RemoteKit). Added deepCloneKit helper for safe deep copies before in-place mutation. Fixed shallow copy bugs in all 12 KitChange helpers, CopyDesign, DeletePiecesAndConnectionsInDesign, and test callers. Fixed guid-unique validation message to match cross-language parity. Updated all test and benchmark callers. All tests pass.
